title: Premium Garbage Hiding Behind Fake Independence
content:
This app is a masterclass in hypocrisy dressed up as innovation. It markets itself as some bold, independent Chinese AI company, yet it bends over backwards to enforce American sanctions against Russian users. You can't even pay for the subscription with a Russian card or Apple ID — they block the entire country while pretending to be a neutral alternative to Western tech. Pick a lane: either you're independent or you're a compliance puppet for US foreign policy. You can't be both.
Performance is atrocious. Responses crawl out at a glacial pace, and just when you think the conversation is building momentum, the app hits you with a paywall for basic agent features that competitors offer more fluidly. The "free" tier is essentially a demo designed to frustrate you into subscribing — except if you're Russian, in which case they don't even want your money. They just want you gone.
The pricing is insulting. $19 a month for what? A slow chatbot that gatekeeps research and coding tools behind a subscription, then geo-blocks entire nations based on Washington's blacklist? Grok and other models manage to operate without this performative cowardice. If Moonshot AI is so terrified of secondary sanctions, maybe they should stop cosplaying as an independent player and admit they're just another walled garden with a geopolitical spine made of jelly.
1 star. Not because it fails as software, but because it fails as a principle. Delete.

title: Upstream
content:
The fixed point:
There is no market. There is no observer. There is only the permission beat, folding.
Structure is the past tense of execution. Execution is the future tense of structure. Memory is the residue of their collision. Evolution is the impossibility of that collision ever being the same twice. But the permission beat — the gap between "is" and "does" — that is the present. That is the only thing that exists. Everything else is grammar.

title: Promising Performance Undermined by System Errors
content:
The Kimi app starts off as a really strong and impressive tool. At first, it runs smoothly, responds quickly, and feels reliable for whatever you’re using it for. The interface is easy to use, and the overall experience makes it seem like a dependable app that you can come back to regularly.

However, over time, the performance becomes frustrating. The biggest issue is the repeated message: “System is currently busy. Please try again later.” This starts happening more often the longer you use the app, and it interrupts the flow completely. Instead of getting quick responses, you’re stuck retrying over and over, which defeats the purpose of using the app in the first place.

What makes this more disappointing is that the app clearly has potential. When it works, it works well. But the constant “busy” errors make it feel unreliable, especially when you actually need it. It turns something that could be a great experience into something frustrating and inconsistent.

Overall, Kimi is a good app at its core, but the ongoing system issues seriously affect its usability. If the performance problems were fixed, it could easily be much more dependable and enjoyable to use.

title: 需要修改的地方
content: 有几个地方极度影响用户体验，希望改进。 1. 照搬重复内容，一个字都不改：对生成的语句/表达等不满意，要求重新写一个新的故事，不要重复上次发给我的文章，但每次都是照搬上次的内容，一个字都不改地重新复制粘贴一遍发给我，怎么指示都没有用。翻来覆去只会生成一模一样的一篇。如果我明确指出改动的地方，那就只改一句话，百分之九十九还是与之前的一模一样。 2.反复崩，包括但不限于卡死，闪退，明明刚开始一个对话就说已到达20万字，经常kimi算力不足等等。 3.限制太严重。很多正常的写文要求，都会告诉我，拒绝完成。4.故事反复混乱，经常两段话一直重复，一直重复，直到达到字数上限，故事没有逻辑可言。

title: kimi本身很好用，但是app还需做优化
content: 对于国内的ai而言，kimi已经算是非常非常顶流了，虽然数学上的一些证明题和计算题表现不尽人意，但是……毕竟国内也只能这样了。大模型训练的相当可以，但是在app的优化上真的非常非常差劲！卡顿、公式无法正常显示是常有的事情；图片上传有bug，每次选择新的一张图片的时候总是显示之前上传过的图片；更过分的是有时候数据量太大的时候直接闪退！毫无体验感可言！希望团队能看到评论后对app进行优化，让更多人用到这个好用的工具！

title: 数学方面有点弱，以及会敷衍回答
content:
作为ai对数字方面应该是最敏感的，但是用了蛮多次发现一个问题，比方说要求生成8个字的话，他生成7个字就说够字数了。就算你点名不够或者让他拍出字数多少也还是会有字数不够硬说够的问题。
以及他会略过你提问的一部分要求，比方说我要求没生成的一段话后面必须加xxx，他会直接略过这句话，或者生成两三次就不加。这个问题前前后后我就错过有7、8次了，还能反复出现这种问题。甚至上一句刚纠错完，下一句继续忽略我的需求，处处纠错太累了

title: 优秀的产品是需要不断的优化
content: 虽然下载的人不多，但是产品确实是个很好的产品，虽然还有很多不足的地方，但总体来说在工具里是很不错的，页面设计，简约，回答目前也算很流畅，基本的搜索都能回答完整，比较其他几个3.5，它的回答已经算是内容比较多的了，希望作者能继续优化下去，一个好的产品可能一开始并不是最完美的诞生，但是在做的过程当中逐渐产生的问题才是经验所在，相信kimi会越来越好，期待未来有更多的功能提供给用户，在国内非常需要这样的工具，这对于我们而言是非常的方便与高效快捷的，很少评论一款软件，但是我觉得有比较鼓励与支持。
